nodes.text: Mind the fence — the hens think it's a *suggestion*.

choices.text: Need a hand around the farm?

nodes.text: Coming in *fat and golden*, thank the rain. If you've a plot of your own, get seeds in the ground before the season turns — soil doesn't hold grudges, but it does hold schedules.
Ha! Careful what you offer — there's always mud that needs moving. Come back when the notice board goes up; I'll have a list as long as a hoe.
